$comment: Bug 095: sentiment faces of the Patient Feedback rating matrix (src/components/feedback/RatingFace.astro), keyed by the option values of the `rating` fields in src/data/forms.json 'feedback'. PROVISIONAL, NOT CLIENT-APPROVED (docs/open-decisions.md F095): Figma has no five-level face set. Shapes = the four Figma face icons of the Your Opinion Matters pop-up (112:7878: Excellent / Good / Medium / Poor), the 'dissatisfied' face = the Figma 'Good' face with its mouth turned down (derived, not designed). Colours = the selected-state sample colours Figma gives those four pop-up faces (#22B573 / #15ADBF / #FFD939 / #FF4E4E, figma-cache/forms-spec.md), 'dissatisfied' = the midpoint of Medium and Poor (#FF9444, derived). These are not brand colours (BG1 maps the pop-up's Medium / Poor to Soft Steel Blue / Deep Teal, which reads as no sentiment): change the hex values here once the client approves a set; the face outlines stay Deep Teal on every colour, so contrast does not depend on them.
